subject.title: fix(gateway): reap stale MCP processes on session reset regardless of…

question: Which lifecycle contract should gate MCP runtime retirement during session reset/delete timeouts?
rationale: The stale-process bug is real, but choosing immediate force-close, explicit force-clear, or lease-deferred retirement changes active-run and MCP tool semantics and needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Repair lifecycle contract first
options.body: Require retirement only after drain, force-clear, or deferred final lease release, with reset/delete timeout tests before merge.

options.title: Accept immediate disposal risk
options.body: Allow reset/delete to close MCP transports under a still-active old run as an explicit availability tradeoff.

options.title: Pause for broader MCP runtime repair
options.body: Hold or close this narrow branch if maintainers want the stale-process cluster solved through an atomic lease/deferred-retirement runtime design.

recommendation.title: Repair lifecycle contract first
recommendation.body: Require retirement only after drain, force-clear, or deferred final lease release, with reset/delete timeout tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is assigned to this PR and already made the clearest related lifecycle-safety decision on the closed rebind PR.
